<assessment>The source shows a street-level corner view of a glazed tower, an attached stepped wing descending left toward a low-rise end block, planted terraces, and a beige neighboring building with punched windows. Pale projecting facade grids, recessed glazing and transparent lower storeys define the main building. CURRENT preserves the broad arrangement but shows solid, unarticulated masses: openings, facade relief and terrace assemblies are missing. Rear elevations, hidden connections and exact dimensions are not established by the source; canonical views cannot prove their fidelity or joint construction.</assessment>

action: Locally form terrace surfaces, perimeter edges and recessed bays at the visible setbacks, including the planted terraces above the low wing. Connect these assemblies to the adjoining enclosure; avoid floating edges or slabs extending through walls. Infer concealed roof areas conservatively.</issue>
